purpose: Check supplied output roles, containment, reserved paths, reparse components and overwrite policy without writing.
trigger: Use before creating a runtime report, native model, or other run output.

inputs.name: output_paths
inputs.description: Role->path mapping or records {role,path,overwrite}; one unique role per path.

inputs.name: overwrite_policy
inputs.description: new_only default; run_owned requires per-path overwrite=true and owned_paths membership.

inputs.name: owned_paths
inputs.description: Explicit paths the caller owns and may replace.

preconditions: This helper does not probe parent writability or create a directory. The later writer must validate its immediate parent and permissions. Path acceptance is not successful save/export evidence.
Caller has established the actual run scope and trustworthy input provenance.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed; EX13 returns blocked/eligible and ER11 quarantined/deleted.

postconditions: Check supplied output roles, containment, reserved paths, reparse components and overwrite policy without writing.
Only the declared flat result fields are returned; no desktop or unperformed persistence layer is implied.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host tooling; no SpaceClaim control or geometry mutation is implied.
implementation.notes: Call verify_run_output_path(**payload), or dispatch("EX-07", payload). Rejected inputs raise HostActionError (with code); filesystem failures may propagate OSError. This helper does not probe parent writability or create a directory. The later writer must validate its immediate parent and permissions. Path acceptance is not successful save/export evidence. The linked guide uses conceptual fields; explicitly adapt them to this canonical function interface, never dispatch the guide output directly.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Path collides with baseline, evidence, or another role.
failure_modes.detection: Canonical comparison finds an unsafe collision.

failure_modes.condition: Parent or file cannot satisfy overwrite policy.
failure_modes.detection: Permission, existence, or policy check fails.

recovery.action: Choose a distinct run-owned path and rerun validation.
Use a declared writable run-owned location; do not alter permissions here.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: No accepted path collides with baseline, evidence, or another role.

evidence_level.notes: Deterministic host file/event tests passed; one Windows symlink creation test skipped for missing platform privilege. No desktop observation implied.
